idea-plugin.name: OpenProject Work Packages Tracker
idea-plugin.description:
Work with OpenProject work packages without leaving the IDE.

Features

  • Tasks integration: an OpenProject server for Tools | Tasks & Contexts. Find work packages in Open Task (by project, saved query, assignee or full-text search), switch between them, change the status when closing a task and log the time spent.
  • Work package lists in the OpenProject tool window, like the table in OpenProject: configurable columns, sorting, search, quick filters for project, type, status, priority and assignee, every filter the server offers, saved views and paging. Each list can have its own tab.
  • Work package details in a preview next to the list or in a tab of their own: subject, description, properties, activity, relations and files. Edit every writable attribute, add comments, manage relations and upload or download files.
  • Time logging with the Log Time dialog: date, duration (e.g. 1h 30m), activity and comment.
  • Active task at a glance: the work package of the active task is visible in the status bar (with quick actions), and highlighted in the lists.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 or later.
  • The Issue Trackers plugin (com.intellij.tasks), which provides Tasks & Contexts. It is bundled with 2026.1; from 2026.2 on, install it from JetBrains Marketplace.
  • OpenProject 15 or later.
  • An OpenProject API token, created in OpenProject under My account | Access tokens. OAuth is not supported yet.

To set up, open Settings | Tools | Tasks | Servers, add an OpenProject server and enter its address and API token. The tool window and time logging use the same server. The token is kept in the IDE's password safe.
